facts.fact: Revises F342: Devan orders the first fodder run (four of Bhaskaran's men, a cart and fodder) to leave as soon as the wood road will take a wheel, within three days if the rain allows but liable to be held a day, then weekly while roads allow. Muthu offers to go himself; Devan answers 'After the sealing. I want you at the gate.' Consistent with F289/F291/F393.
Ammu's Valli cloth was shed at the cook-house corner; Muthu found it and laid it at the roots of the tree where she died, beside her resin pouch. Replaces the 'cached before dusk' detail.
